spec_match.rationale: Measures the render quantum where the spec defines it to matter — the block length inside AudioWorkletProcessor.process() — for every hint form (omit, default, hardware, integers) and cross-checks against renderQuantumSize.

interactive.rationale: Hint select + render button runs a real OfflineAudioContext + AudioWorklet render each time; three meters report requested/measured/property.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises an in-engine measurement no engine can fake; the worklet postMessage delivers exactly that.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers pre-feature engines (measured 128 + undefined property, honestly narrated), UA-adjusted hints, the hardware keyword, and a worklet-timeout guard.

conformance.rationale: The suite's worklet-block-matches-property assertion is this page's mechanism as a self-contained async check.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: a real offline render executed, the worklet measured 128 frames for a 256 request with the property unexposed — the honest ground truth — on both viewports with zero console errors; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: rq-meter-measured asserts requested vs measured vs property per run; failures assert separately.

design_system.rationale: Match/classic states in emerald/amber on paper (AA); CSS variables only.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled select; meters grouped aria-live; run button disables during the render.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Meter grid collapses under 640px; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

openQuestions.title: Measure honoured hints on Chrome 153
openQuestions.detail: Re-run each hint on a supporting engine: integer hints should measure as requested (or documented rounding), and 'hardware' should reveal the device's real block size.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer offline rendering for measurements so nothing depends on device playback or user gesture.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: OfflineAudioContext render with a once-only postMessage; no audible output or gesture needed.
Meter grid and status are aria-live with textual values.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): the full render+measure pipeline executed for real on Chromium 141 — worklet reported 128 frames against a 256 request with the property unexposed, precisely the honest pre-feature truth. Clean console, both viewports.
